body: https://konard.github.io/network/?code=1111&rotation=-90&turns=%2C-15+15&gaps=%2C0.18+0.18 `Turn of the source, °` and `Turn of the target, °` should be paired under the separator line as other paired settings, so it is easy for user to edit them. Also turns should be replaced with sliders from -180 to +180 degrees, and there should be reset button for each individual setting. And the step should be 1 degree by default. Also previously I asked to make sliders configurable by left/right arrows on keyboard, that is not working at the moment. `Gap at the source/target reference` now looks like between 0 and 100%, so it also should be a slider. When we see that like in this case (perpendicular to each other), for our other link from self-referencing (top link in example) we should prefer do symmetrical settings, like if they were on the same circumference. So in this specific case as our fully closed self referencing link is already considered symmetrical, we should also make references to it symmetrical by default in our auto gaps solver. Also if gaps already configured nicely within the gap margin manually, automatic tool should do nothing, unless some criteria on gaps are not met. These are too valid solution, yet if we have wide range of solutions, we should prefer such configuration, where gaps between references and other shapes are equal an uniform, and we should use by default steps of 1 degree, not 5 or 10. https://konard.github.io/network/?code=1111&rotation=-90&turns=0+5%2C-5+5&gaps=0.08+%7E+0%2C0.18+0.18+0 https://konard.github.io/network/?code=1111&rotation=-90&turns=0+5%2C-10+10&gaps=0.08+%7E+0%2C0.18+0.18+0 And for `https://konard.github.io/network/?code=1111&rotation=-90&turns=0+5%2C-15+15&gaps=0.08+%7E+0%2C0.18+0.18+0` when auto gaps enabled the change is too drastic: And here it is visible they didn't land on same circumference or same horizontal line, which would be the same. Also gab between references of top links (its ends) is too much in auto configuration by default. Double check make our defaults as perfect as possible. Yet auto gaps still continues to be experimental, as it still fails in some tested cases. We surely need to increase tests coverage. We need to continue improvements from https://github.com/konard/konard.github.io/issues/27 (and all previous issues), we need to make sure all reordered requirements are fully delivered, on contradictions prefer newest requirements over oldest. We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration. If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them. Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
